title: Spaghetti Carbonara
description: Roman-style pasta tossed with crisp pancetta, eggs, Pecorino and black pepper into a creamy sauce with no cream at all.

image.alt: A plate of spaghetti carbonara with crisp pork and black pepper

ingredients.scaleNote: Use a big pot of water whatever the batch size.
It seasons the pasta water; the pancetta and cheese are salty, so go easy.

ingredients.note: plus 1 extra yolk if you have it

steps.text: Bring the water and salt to a boil and cook the spaghetti until al dente. Save {qty 1 cup fixed} of pasta water before draining.
Meanwhile cook the pancetta in the skillet over medium heat until crisp and the fat has rendered, {time 6-8 min}. Take the pan off the heat.
Whisk the eggs, cheese and most of the pepper in a bowl into a thick paste.
Add the drained pasta to the pancetta and toss. Let it cool for {time 1 min} so the eggs won’t scramble.

Pour in the egg mixture with a splash of pasta water and toss quickly and constantly until a glossy, creamy sauce coats the pasta. Add more pasta water as needed. Serve right away with the rest of the pepper.

notes: The pan must be warm but not hot when the eggs go in. If the sauce looks thin, toss over the lowest heat for a few seconds; if it clumps, add pasta water and toss off the heat.
